pilgrimage.png.prompt: Edit / background extraction for a production game asset. Reference image: the attached original typography board. Extract and faithfully recreate ONLY its four enormous Chinese title characters, exactly '绯线巡礼', with the crimson thread that passes through their bronze eyelets. Preserve the reference's dramatic distinctive glyph construction: extremely acute needle-like triangular terminals, individually cut jagged diagonal strokes, sculpted broad strokes of weathered bone or old parchment, tiny edge chips and restrained speckled distress, black pierced holes rimmed in antique bronze, a single very thin tactile vermilion red thread. The original reference's sharp custom lettering silhouette and material quality are the entire point. Four characters on one horizontal line, generous transparent margins but tightly composed. Real alpha transparency around lettering, inside counters, between letters. No environment, no dark background, no border, no English subtitle, no additional Chinese text, no labels, no effects/glow/shadows outside letters. Do not substitute normal Song/Ming font shapes, do not round off the pointed strokes. Wide horizontal aspect ratio 3:1. This is an actual transparent title asset to place over a dark game interface.
